content.introduction: The Yahoo Finance dashboard lists NU Nu Holdings Ltd. and INTC Intel Corporation among the most active stocks, with INTC showing a significant gain of +3.71%. The top gainers include UTHR United Therapeutics Corporation with a substantial increase of +12.55%. The bond market shows mixed results, with the 5-Yr Bond and 10-Yr Bond both rising by +1.15% and +1.03% respectively, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF declined by -0.65%. The sources do not provide detailed sector performance data beyond these figures.
